srep-0029-effect-meanings.pending: needs measured values: the SREP's Conformance table gives colours and lattice properties, not centroids or sizes, and the case document is schema-valid only; the six checks need per-effect cases with measured output

srep-0030-grid-line-width.pending: needs a measured value: the SREP gives line widths (4, 1, 3, 0 px) but not the positions or the picture, and the pattern origin and the 200x200 asset's placement are not stated analytically

srep-0032-resample-filters.pending: needs a measured value: the SREP's Conformance table compares texel values after magnification and states no centroid or region, and the SREP itself records that nothing was measured (Motivation: not measured yet)

srep-0035-preset-ease-curves.pending: the SREP states the offset as 0.5 em * (1 - f(0.4)) but the glyph position of 'I' depends on the font, so no centroid is derived here; needs a measured value from the engine

srep-0036-geo-fill-whole.pending: the SREP expects the red interior at progress 0, 0.5 and 1 (exact colour); the case fixes progress 0.5 only and the kit has no region entry derived here

srep-0036-geo-outline-progress.pending: the SREP gives pixel-count ratios (a third to two thirds of the full outline's white pixels at 0.5), which the kit's centroid/size entries cannot express; needs a measured pixel count

srep-0037-text3d-tracking.pending: the SREP gives a relative expectation (stem distance grows by tracking * 0.1 px = 20 px at tracking 200), not an absolute position; needs the baseline measured from the same document with tracking removed

srep-0038-model-material-override.pending: marker.glb has unnamed materials, so a materialOverride pair cannot match; needs a model with named materials

srep-0039-unevenness-varies.pending: the SREP expects the luminance variance across the lit face to exceed a floor it does not state; needs a measured value

srep-0041-shadow-catcher.pending: the darkening ratio E_sh / E_un depends on the engine's light model; needs a measured value

srep-0041-shadow-catcher-opacity.pending: the SREP states the darkening halves at opacity 0.5 (a ratio against the opacity 1 case), not an absolute value; needs measured values for both

srep-0042-clip-blend-unknown.pending: the finding (an unknown second clip is reported) is a report finding, not a pixel; checked by the engine's own test

srep-0043-joint-socket.pending: needs a model with a named, animated joint; the kit's only model (marker.glb) has none, so no pixel expectation can be derived without inventing one

srep-0046-morph-by-name.pending: needs a model with named morph targets; the kit's only model (marker.glb) has none, so the SREP's 40 px displacements cannot be reproduced without inventing a model or numbers

srep-0047-joint-pose.pending: needs a model with named, jointed nodes; the kit's only model (marker.glb) has none, so the SREP's socket displacements and look-at angles cannot be reproduced without inventing a model or numbers

srep-0051-wiggle-smooth.pending: the SREP states no pixel-level expectation: the wiggled points come from the engine's seeded noise, so no centroid or size can be computed analytically; its check compares vertices and turn angles of smooth against corner, which the kit's colour-centroid measure cannot express
